understanding.goal_understanding: The objective is to navigate each level’s grid to complete all goal cells. A goal cell can only be completed by stepping onto it when the carried piece’s shape, color, and rotation exactly match that goal’s required attributes; finishing all goals advances to the next level, and finishing all levels wins.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Each move (north/south/east/west) costs 1 stamina; when stamina reaches 0 you lose 1 life and stamina resets to max, and losing all lives ends the game. Walls block movement; the state provides a list of blocked_directions that must never be chosen because they waste a turn/stamina without moving. Stepping on modifier tiles changes the piece: shape changers cycle shapes 0–5 (wrap), color changers cycle colors in order orange→blue→green→red→orange, and rotation changers rotate 90° clockwise (0→90→180→270→0). A goal becomes activated only when all three attributes match, and then stepping onto that goal completes it; optional stamina refill tiles restore stamina.
